hypothesis_result.interpretation: The 15-degree stop was too coarse: health closed at about 2.6 degrees before the first hold. Features were intermittently visible again during some later stationary holds, but the latched localization health stayed invalid and map input_ready stayed false. This run therefore did not test whether a pause before the 2.6-degree failure threshold can preserve health.

code_changes: Added explicit SIGINT/SIGTERM handlers to run_sensor_motion.py so a background sensor-motion process can clear its persistent wrench and save partial truth on cooperative stop.
Added explicit stop handlers to record_n04_mapping_inputs.py so recorder input can be saved on cooperative stop.
Extended run_n04_map_layout.sh docker stop grace from 15 to 90 seconds.
Added an eight-step 1-degree pilot profile that stops at each increment and holds the view for 5.16 seconds while retaining the r22 angular acceleration.

next_experiment.primary_variable: maximum uninterrupted yaw increment, reduced from 15 degrees to 1 degree; angular acceleration, stationary location and textured surround stay fixed, with fixed-view holds after each microstep.
next_experiment.hypothesis: If feature/health loss depends on uninterrupted viewpoint change, a pause before 2.6 degrees will keep localization valid through the first 8 degrees and allow a fresh map to continue receiving data.
next_experiment.health_lock_stop: Because run_sensor_motion.py and record_n04_mapping_inputs.py now install SIGINT handlers, signal the motion process group in-container; the runner can then stop recorders and mapping in order and persist partial files.
next_experiment.success_criterion: Localization health remains valid through all eight microstep holds, map identity/freshness stays current, and the recorder contains forwarded depth and camera poses after the first 2.6-degree boundary. A pilot success is not a full-turn coverage or N06 pass.
